status: Candidate, not adopted. Combined CPU is practically tied with VLC; overlapping run ranges do not establish a reliable CPU or overall win.
method: Same matched-video/linear/D3D11VA/calibrated-cycle protocol as the preceding batch. Fresh portable profiles, same app EXE and native DLL for both Aperture variants; only explicit guarded native flags differ. One discarded warmup plus three measured rounds in rotated order, approximately 30-second windows. No builders/profilers during timing.
cpuCalibration: Hardware-specific cycle estimate uses the retained invariant-TSC/rate/busy-counter validation measured immediately after the batch; sampled CPU time is retained as a diagnostic.
nativeScreens: Single-run screens showed backbuffer reuse reducing CPU work; skipping eager Flush worsened it, and gpu-next and disabled timer-resolution requests did not improve it. Screens isolate hypotheses and do not establish player rankings.
functional: Combined flags passed the original 59 functional playback checks. Candidate and original each passed 15 geometry checks, including pause/resize/rotation/resume and H264-to-HDR-HEVC reconfiguration. The five fixed paused captures are byte-identical across original and candidate. These MPV window captures are not an exhaustive physical-display/pacing check.
limits: One H264 fixture and one machine; a broader playback win remains unproven.
Visible window is not first video frame.
